name: Wall of Force

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a dome or globe up to 10 feet in radius, or ten connected 10-foot panels

summary: An invisible wall of force that nothing can physically cross.
text: Make a dome or globe up to 10 feet in radius, or a surface of up to ten 10-foot panels. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by Dispel Magic, but Disintegrate destroys it; it reaches into the Ethereal Plane too.
